body_en:
Whatever race you belong to, whatever religion you belong to, whichever country you belong to, everybody gets the same anubhuti. The basis on which 'Shree Sant Gyaneshwar' had spoken about 'global religion' - you will be able to understand that knowledge too. All of you are invited over there.

Lots of blessings to all of you.

Note: Shibir will be in the Marathi language

Your own
Baba Swami
3|4|2025
(Shivkrupanand Swami)
